description: v1.2.2 文档层修正（来自一次真实上线）：新增硬约束 C12（--force 是一次性诊断，跑完必须还原）+ 发布验收铁律（新集必须是 manifest/RSS 第 1 条；验收看 gh-pages blob 而非 HTTP；index.html 是 JS 外壳不可作判据）+ 纠正 C3 max_tokens 指引（思考型模型需 12000，否则 content 为空）。代码层不变：卡兹克必做强阻断（C11）+ humanize_stage 生命周期 + pii_scan.llm_verify + phase5_summary + ErrorPolicy + 57 单测。

displayDescription.en: Turn Markdown articles into a published podcast: smart script splitting, REQUIRED Khazix human-voice polish (hard-gate C11), AI voice (MiniMax/edge-tts/fish-speech), RSS and a dark-themed site, one-click deploy. v1.2.2 (docs-only): new hard-constraint C12 (--force is a one-shot diagnostic that must be reverted) + release-acceptance rules (new episode must be manifest/RSS item #1; verify the gh-pages blob, not HTTP) + corrected reasoning-model max_tokens guidance. Carries v1.2.1's mandatory Khazix, pii_scan.llm_verify, phase5_summary, ErrorPolicy and 57 unit tests.
